sop_modules.name: Ceiling Inspection and Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Inspect primed ceiling surface for imperfections. Spackle, sand, and spot finish any defects found. Required prep before finish coat. NOT included in QT2 (economy work).

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface
tasks.description: Walk and visually inspect primed ceiling with work light. Mark any imperfections: nail pops, dings, scratches, missed spots, rough areas, drips from prime phase. Mark defects for repair.

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed overhead inspection of primed ceiling using bright work light. Mark all defects including minor imperfections. QT4 requires comprehensive defect identification.

quality_notes.QT4: Comprehensive inspection under bright light, mark all defects

tasks.name: Inspect Primed Ceiling Surface (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical overhead inspection using raking light with multiple passes. Semi-gloss+ finishes show every imperfection - all defects must be identified and marked.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection with raking light, multiple passes. Semi-gloss+ shows everything.

tasks.name: Spackle Ceiling Imperfections
tasks.description: Apply lightweight spackle to marked imperfections: fill nail pops, dings, scratches. Feather edges for smooth transition. Use extension pole-mounted spackle applicator for production efficiency.

quality_notes.QT3: Fill all marked defects, reasonable feathering
quality_notes.QT4: Fill all defects with careful feathering for invisible repairs

tasks.name: Spackle Ceiling Imperfections (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical spackle work on ceiling with wide feathering and multiple thin coats as needed. Slower application for semi-gloss+ finish preparation. Perfect surface required.

quality_notes.QT5: Wide feathering, multiple thin coats. Perfect surface required for semi-gloss+

tasks.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Ceiling
tasks.description: Sand spackled areas smooth after dry. Use pole sander with fine grit (150-180). Blend repairs into surrounding surface.

quality_notes.QT3: Sand and blend, repair should not telegraph
quality_notes.QT4: Sand perfectly smooth, repair should be invisible

tasks.name: Sand Spackled Areas on Ceiling (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical sanding of spackled areas to perfection. Use wet sponge test for smoothness. No imperfections acceptable under semi-gloss+ finish.

quality_notes.QT5: Sand to perfection, wet sponge test for smoothness. No imperfections acceptable.

tasks.name: Spot Prime Spackled Areas on Ceiling
tasks.description: Apply spot primer or thinned ceiling paint to spackled areas to seal repairs before finish coat. Prevents flashing.

quality_notes.QT4: Spot prime all repairs, feather edges
quality_notes.QT5: Spot prime all repairs with wide feather, may need light sand after spot prime

tasks.name: Vacuum Repair Dust from Ceiling
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from ceiling surface after repairs. Prevents contamination of finish coat.

quality_notes.all: Thorough vacuum of all repaired and surrounding areas

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Inspect → Spackle defects → Dry time → Sand spackle → Spot prime → Vacuum dust. All repair work must be complete and dry before finish coat.

sop_modules.name: Ceiling Paint Preparation - Premium/Critical
sop_modules.description: Additional prep for QT4/QT5: light sand entire primed ceiling surface before finish coat. Critical for higher sheen finishes.

tasks.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Ceiling
tasks.description: Light sand entire primed ceiling surface with pole sander and 220 grit to degloss and smooth. Prepares surface for optimal finish coat adhesion. Required for QT4/QT5.

quality_notes.QT4: Light even pass over entire ceiling, focus on any remaining nibs or imperfections

tasks.name: Light Sand Entire Primed Ceiling (Critical)
tasks.description: Thorough sanding of entire primed ceiling surface with raking light inspection. Critical for semi-gloss+ finishes which show every imperfection.

quality_notes.QT5: Thorough even sanding with raking light inspection. Semi-gloss+ shows every imperfection.

tasks.name: Vacuum Sanding Dust from Ceiling
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from entire ceiling surface using HEPA vacuum with brush attachment.

quality_notes.QT5: Complete vacuum of entire ceiling, tack cloth follow-up recommended

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Sand entire ceiling → Vacuum sanding dust. QT4/QT5 - performed AFTER inspection/repair module.

sop_modules.name: Protection Setup - Ceiling Paint
sop_modules.description: Set up or verify protection for ceiling fixtures and window/door openings before painting.

tasks.name: Verify/Apply Window Masking
tasks.description: Check if window masking from prime phase is intact. If missing or damaged, apply plastic film over openings and tape perimeter. Prevents overspray fallout and roller splatter from landing on windows.

quality_notes.all: Verify seal is complete, no gaps. Replace damaged masking.

tasks.name: Verify/Apply Door Masking
tasks.description: Check if door masking from prime phase is intact. If missing or damaged, apply plastic film and tape perimeter. Prevents overspray fallout and roller splatter.

quality_notes.all: Verify seal is complete, no gaps. Replace damaged masking.

tasks.name: Protect Ceiling Fixtures
tasks.description: Stuff recessed lighting cans with paper and tape over face. Stuff ceiling electrical boxes (junction boxes, smoke detector locations) with paper and tape. May already be in place from prime phase - verify or apply.

quality_notes.all: Verify protection is complete on all ceiling fixtures

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Verify/apply window masking → Verify/apply door masking → Protect ceiling fixtures. All protection must be verified/complete before painting.

sop_modules.name: Apply Ceiling Paint - Roller Method
sop_modules.description: Apply ceiling finish paint using roller method.

tasks.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply ceiling finish paint using 9-inch or 18-inch roller with extension pole. Work in sections, maintain wet edge. Can roll 1-2 inches onto wall area (wall painter will cover).

quality_notes.QT2: Full coverage, minor lap marks acceptable
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks - first of two coats
quality_notes.QT5: Critical application - uniform coverage, perfect technique. First of two coats for semi-gloss+ finish.

tasks.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 1 (Textured)
tasks.description: Apply ceiling finish paint to textured surface (orange peel, knockdown) using roller with 3/4-inch nap cover. Requires more product and slower application than smooth ceilings.

quality_notes.QT3: Complete coverage of texture, minimal lap marks
quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, texture valleys filled, no lap marks

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Single coat for QT2-QT3. QT4/QT5 uses this module for first coat, then sand, then second coat.

sop_modules.name: Apply Ceiling Paint - Roller Method (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second ceiling finish coat using roller method. QT4/QT5 premium work.

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Light sand first coat with 220 grit pole sander to smooth any nibs or imperfections before second coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Light even pass to smooth nibs before second coat

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats (Critical)
tasks.description: Careful sanding between coats with inspection under work light. Critical for semi-gloss+ finishes where every imperfection shows.

quality_notes.QT5: Careful sanding with inspection between coats. Critical for semi-gloss+.

tasks.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from ceiling before applying second coat.

tasks.name: Roll Ceiling Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second ceiling finish coat. Same technique as first coat.

quality_notes.QT4: Uniform coverage, no visible lap marks, consistent sheen
quality_notes.QT5: Perfect coverage, flawless technique. Semi-gloss+ finish requires perfect uniformity.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Light sand coat 1 → Vacuum → Apply coat 2. QT4/QT5 premium work.

sop_modules.name: Apply Ceiling Paint - Spray + Backroll Method
sop_modules.description: Apply ceiling finish paint via spray followed by immediate backroll.

tasks.name: Spray Ceiling Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Apply ceiling finish paint via airless sprayer. Maintain proper distance, 50% overlap, consistent speed. Backroller follows immediately.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical spray application - perfect overlap, consistent mil thickness. First of two coats.

tasks.name: Backroll Ceiling Finish Coat 1
tasks.description: Immediately follow ceiling spray with 18-inch roller to consolidate paint, eliminate air pockets, and level finish. Backroller sets pace for sprayer.

quality_notes.QT5: Perfect backroll technique - uniform finish critical for semi-gloss+ sheen

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray → Backroll (immediately). Backroller must follow sprayer closely. Single coat for QT2-QT3. QT4/QT5 use two coats.

sop_modules.name: Apply Ceiling Paint - Spray + Backroll (Coat 2)
sop_modules.description: Apply second ceiling finish coat via spray+backroll. QT4/QT5 premium work.

tasks.name: Light Sand Between Coats
tasks.description: Light sand first coat with 220 grit pole sander before second coat.

tasks.name: Vacuum Intercoat Sanding Dust
tasks.description: Remove sanding dust from ceiling before applying second coat.

tasks.name: Spray Ceiling Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Apply second ceiling finish coat via airless spray.

quality_notes.QT5: Perfect application - flawless finish for semi-gloss+

tasks.name: Backroll Ceiling Finish Coat 2
tasks.description: Backroll second coat immediately after spray.

quality_notes.QT5: Perfect backroll - flawless sheen uniformity required

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Light sand → Vacuum → Spray coat 2 → Backroll coat 2. QT4/QT5 premium work.

sop_modules.name: Apply Ceiling Paint - Spray Only Method
sop_modules.description: Apply ceiling finish paint via spray without backroll.

tasks.name: Spray Ceiling Finish (No Backroll)
tasks.description: Apply ceiling finish paint via airless sprayer. Higher overlap required when not backrolling to ensure even coverage.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Spray-only achieves final finish in single pass. No backroll.

sop_modules.name: Cleanup - Ceiling Paint
sop_modules.description: Vacuum subfloors, remove protection, clean tools, final inspection.

tasks.name: Vacuum Subfloors
tasks.description: Vacuum subfloors to remove paint drips, overspray debris, and dust from ceiling painting.

tasks.name: Remove Ceiling Fixture Protection
tasks.description: Remove paper and tape from recessed lights and ceiling electrical boxes.
tasks.notes: Leave window/door masking in place if walls will be painted next

tasks.name: Clean Tools
tasks.description: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Store or dispose properly.

tasks.name: Final Ceiling Inspection
tasks.description: Walk and inspect all painted ceiling surfaces. Check for holidays, lap marks, coverage issues. Touch up as needed.

tasks.name: Final Ceiling Inspection (Premium)
tasks.description: Detailed inspection of all painted ceiling surfaces with work light. Perfect finish expected. Touch up any defects found.

quality_notes.QT4: Detailed inspection with work light, perfect finish expected

tasks.name: Final Ceiling Inspection (Critical)
tasks.description: Critical inspection under raking light for semi-gloss+ finish. Any imperfection must be identified and addressed. Semi-gloss+ finishes are unforgiving.

quality_notes.QT5: Critical inspection under raking light. Semi-gloss+ is unforgiving - any imperfection must be addressed.

sop_modules.sequence_notes: Vacuum subfloor → Remove ceiling protection (leave window/door masking for wall painters) → Clean tools → Final inspection.

round_configurations.name: Single Finish Coat
round_configurations.description: Standard single coat of ceiling finish paint.
round_configurations.notes: Single coat over properly primed surface is typically sufficient.

round_configurations.name: Two Coat Finish
round_configurations.description: Premium two coat ceiling finish with light sand between coats. QT4 for eggshell, QT5 for semi-gloss+.
round_configurations.notes: Two coats for maximum hide and uniformity. Light sand between coats. QT5 adds critical inspection steps for semi-gloss+ finishes.
